narrative.overview:
A deep blue field with a sky glow carries the page. Frosted white glass floats on it for the two things that orient the buyer: the navigation bar, and the money rail that shows where their money is right now. Products and prices never sit on glass; they sit on solid white sheets, so the eye moves from a luminous, moving layer to a calm, legible one.

The structure comes from a ledger: a status line for the money, a seal for each verified shop, the next step shown first. The material of that ledger is translated into glass. On the home page, the promise is a large headline, proved at once by a working rail laid over a shelf of real product photographs. On buying screens the same promise returns as a small hold note, and the density stays that of a working marketplace, with 14px body text.

The name "Trao" and the droplet logo are provisional. The owner has not chosen a final name, so nothing here depends on the word or on the logo's exact drawing. The rename tool does not touch Markdown files, so a rename means updating this file by hand.
keyCharacteristics: Deep blue field with translucent sky glow behind the header, the hero and the flash band.
Blurred glass on exactly two components: the navigation bar and the money rail.
Solid white sheets for everything that is read, compared or bought.
Ink prices, midnight count badges, and red kept for discounts, errors and destructive actions.
One signature motion: a water drop moving along the money rail, which stops on the first click and is absent under reduced motion.
Fine-line seals generated from each shop's id, so no two shops share a mark.

rules.name: The Ink Price Rule
rules.body: Every price is Ink Text with tabular figures. A price in blue reads as a link; a price in red reads as a shouting sale.

rules.name: The Rationed Red Rule
rules.body: Red means a discount, an error or a destructive action, and nothing else. It does not mark urgency, favourites, required fields or decoration. The flash band itself is blue; only its percent badges and sold bars are red.

rules.name: The Midnight Count Rule
rules.body: Count badges on the cart, notifications and chat are Midnight Blue with white figures. A count is information, not an alarm.

rules.name: The Sky Is Light Rule
rules.body: Sky is never a solid fill behind white text. It may glow translucently into the deep blue field, where sampled chip fills in the review captures stay near or above 4.8:1 against white, and it may tint a surface carrying midnight text. The logo and water drop start in sky and deepen to blue; those are marks, not text.

rules.name: The Cyan Is Not Brand Rule
rules.body: The `--blue-*` tokens are the information role. Brand work uses `--brand-*`; a button, general link or selected state is never drawn from `--blue-*`. An inline link inside an information note may stay in the information colour.

rules.name: The Stacked Diacritic Rule
rules.body: Headlines that can wrap keep a line height of at least 1.14, so stacked Vietnamese marks such as those in "Nhận" and "đến" never touch the line above. Check every new heading against real Vietnamese copy.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Money, counts and countdowns use tabular figures so that columns and ticking clocks do not jitter.

rules.name: The Glass Is For Finding Your Way Rule
rules.body: Blurred glass belongs to the navigation bar and the money rail, nothing else. Products, prices, forms, popovers and modals are solid. Plain translucent white without blur, such as category chips and the countdown on the blue field, is not glass and is allowed there.

rules.name: The Quiet Sheet Rule
rules.body: A reading sheet never goes beyond the Small shadow and never gets a blur or a tint. Product cards take no shadow at all.

rules.name: The Opaque Fallback Rule
rules.body: Under `prefers-reduced-transparency`, glass becomes solid white with no blur. Everything on glass must already be legible on white.

dos: Do keep every reading surface solid white, with glass reserved for the navigation bar and the money rail.
Do set every price in Ink Text with tabular figures, at every scale including small popovers.
Do use Midnight Blue for count badges.
Do repeat the money promise beside each buying decision with the Hold Note, and show the solid rail with real values once money has moved.
Do show a Shop Seal beside the shop name in buying contexts.
Do stop automatic motion on first interaction and remove it entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do give every new control a 44px minimum hit target, including icon buttons and rail stops on phones.
Do treat "Trao" and the logo as replaceable, keeping them out of any rule that would break on a rename.
donts: Don't put product, price or form content on blurred glass.
Don't use red for urgency, favourites, required markers or decoration, or as a background for a whole flash-sale section.
Don't set white text on a solid sky fill.
Don't use `--blue-*` as a brand colour, or `--brand-*` to mean information.
Don't use orange as a brand colour, or anything that makes the page read as Shopee, Lazada or Tiki.
Don't bring glass, pills or the blue field into Vendor or Admin, and don't bring their dark ink chrome into the storefront.
